rules.no_second_owner: Cues identify sparse high-value exact visual learning moments only. They do not copy or replace canonical medical Core or the original Lecture.
rules.precision_absence: Absence from this index does not downgrade any canonical KP or fact.
rules.first_pass: Visual cues support the accepted D Source-contact and retrieval route; they do not create a second source-contact sequence.
rules.visual_behavior: Show a reviewed Project Source visual at the decisive spatial learning moment with one bounded micro-task. Missing visual bytes remain legal and fail-closed.
rules.source_truth: Exact medical meaning remains in canonical D Block/KP content and the referenced Project Source PDF.
